name: The Fresco Court
summary: The palace's painted court: four red columns, a procession on every wall, benches all round and a fire on the altar.
description: Here the household gathers when the wanax is not in the mood for it to gather in his megaron: a court open to the sky, four red columns standing round its crossing, and on every wall a painted procession of women carrying gifts toward a king who is never shown. Plastered benches run along the walls with fleeces thrown over them, offerings wait on painted tables, and a round altar in the corner keeps a fire going for whichever god is currently owed one. It is the ward's crossroads, lit by the altar and by the sky.
build: Shell: the kit's InnerWard shell, 12.0 × 12.0 × 0.30 m slab, 0.50 m painted plaster walls 4.00 m clear, 0.45 m fresco-blue capstone band, an archway 2.60 × 2.88 m centred on every wall.
Procession fresco: a panel 4.10 m wide × 1.60 m tall, 1.40–3.00 m above the floor, on every wall section, with a 0.18 m haematite border on top.

Columns: four down-tapering columns at (±2.40, ±2.40), 4.00 m to the wall top: black base disc r 0.30 × 0.10 m, haematite shaft r 0.17 → 0.23 m, black cushion capital 0.36 m, abacus 0.69 × 0.69 × 0.10 m.
North and south benches: plastered clay, 3.20 × 0.50 × 0.40 m, backed against the walls at x ±3.60, y ±5.25, fleeces on them.
East and west benches: 0.50 × 2.40 × 0.40 m against the walls at x ±5.25, y ±3.40.
Fire altar (NE): a gypsum drum r 0.60 × 0.90 m at (3.60, 3.60), three haematite bands r 0.61 × 0.05 m; the fire (a flame cone r 0.16 × 0.45 m) at its west side, (3.35, 3.60).
Offering tables: two painted tables 0.60 × 0.60 m, 0.70 m high, at (±3.20, −3.40).
Floor: the court's paving grid is painted (albedo only).
sockets: Archway ×4, centred on each wall: 2.60 × 2.88 m (InnerWard), all open
Fire altar: NE, an IGNIS source at 0.90 m

materials.name: Painted lime plaster
materials.notes: Walls; soot over the altar corner.

materials.name: Haematite red
materials.notes: Column shafts, borders, altar bands, the fire.

materials.name: Painted floor
materials.notes: Offering tables; the floor is the zone's ash_hi.

gameplay: The ward's crossroads: every archway opens onto the court, so guards pass through it often.
Seven loot anchors, spread round the walls: easy pickings, in the open.
The columns are the only cover in the middle; the altar fire lights the whole court.
